enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn onto back. Place hands on chest. Turn to left side again. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Close cabinet. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up bowl. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher.

Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Open drawer. Take out underwear. Take out socks. Close drawer. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Tuck shirt into pants. Fasten belt. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to front door. Open door. Step outside. Close door. Lock door with key. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Stand at bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Clock in. Walk to locker room. Open locker. Change into scrubs. Close locker. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review notes. Walk to patient room. Enter room. Check vital signs. Record information. Walk to supply room. Restock gloves. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to nurse station. Answer phone. Assist patient.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bedroom. Change out of work clothes. Put on casual clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Take out pot from cabinet. Fill pot with water. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Add meat. Stir with spoon. Turn off stove. Pour soup into bowl. Place bowl on table. Sit on chair. Eat soup with spoon. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Flip through channels. Stop on a show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Change into pajamas. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Remain still.
